items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: That's why they got Andrew up there. They didn't want Andrew up there.

ctx.x: Well, all right, I'll play the night, I'll play the pro night off. You understand? But be certain somebody. Yeah. That's why they got Andrew up there. They didn't want Andrew up there. They hold him up there a long time up there because he couldn't play enough credit. They wanted credit up there. You see? So he said up there until Sydney come back. Like Trinity.
Do you think it's all right to have the trombone for the leader of the band? Or is it best for the have the carnet to be the leader and call the tunes and stomp off and all? Or the clarinetist?
